output_path.description: Path to the output PNG image. Use '-' for stdout.

database_path.description: Path to the rsbackup database file containing volume metadata.

font_families.description: List of font family names to use for text rendering in the graph.

selectors.description: List of volume selectors (HOST, HOST:VOLUME, -HOST, *) to filter the display.

theme.description: Color theme for the graph output (e.g., 'light', 'dark').

config_path.description: The canonical path to this configuration file.
